whyThisTerminal: the authorization's own terminal for execution that cannot produce interpretable evidence. The calls succeeded; the harness could not read what came back.

HARNESS_DEFECT.whatWentWrong: The probe read res.analysis.clarifications off the provider result. ExpertProviderSuccess carries raw: unknown and NOTHING else — raw output must pass through normalizeExpertOutput to become a validated analysis, and the collections are named expertHazardCandidates and decisionCriticalClarifications. So res.analysis was undefined on every row and every count defaulted to zero.
HARNESS_DEFECT.howItWasCaught: candidateCount was also 0 on all ten rows while the model returned 788-1563 output tokens with stop_reason=tool_use. Structured content was plainly returned, so a uniform zero was a reading failure rather than a model behaviour.
HARNESS_DEFECT.attribution: HARNESS_DEFECT — not a model failure, not an instrument failure
HARNESS_DEFECT.secondDefect: raw provider output was NOT persisted. Only derived counts were written, so when the extraction proved wrong the ten responses became unrecoverable. $0.47437 of model output was destroyed by the harness that measured it.

whatMayNotBeConcluded: the recorded 0/5 REQUIRED_RECALL_LOOSE is a harness artifact and is NOT a model result
the recorded 5/5 SILENCE_PRECISION is equally an artifact — a harness that reads zero clarifications everywhere scores every SILENCE row correct for free
no REQUIRED_RECALL, SILENCE_PRECISION, BALANCED_ACCURACY or ROW_LEVEL_ACCURACY figure from this attempt may be reported, carried forward, or cited
